It also highlights the need for parameter adjustment to account for population-specific anatomical variation.[47]
Relevance To Parametric Modelling Opensc: The paper's approach to parameterizing prosthetic geometry using anthropometric data is directly relevant to OpenSCAD-style workflows, as both rely on explicit parameter definitions and size-driven geometry generation for customization, though the paper uses CATIA for modeling.[47]
